title: Khvostov Incident
text: The Khvostov Incident, called the Bunka Russian invasion in Japan, refers to a series of raids and clashes by Russian Lieutenant Nikolai Alexeyevich Khvostov of the Russian-American Company against Japanese outposts on the islands of Iturup (Etorofu) and Sakhalin in 1806–1807. Khvostov ordered his subordinate Nikolai Rezanov to attack the Japanese with his envoy..
